rationale: MoE+TP save_checkpoint short-circuit caused only mp_rank_00_model_states.pt to be written; non-zero TP ranks silently skipped. Invariant: set of mp_rank_XX_model_states.pt files must cover all X in [0, tp_world_size). Layer schema_topo_precond: requires cross-rank set check AND a precond guard (only applies when MoE+TP>1; non-MoE save path is correct). Pattern P7 (function_call_counting per detection_method: counts of save calls per TP rank). Borderline P3 vs P7: chose P7 because the check is on call-counting / file-emission completeness, not on the equality of a replicated tensor across ranks. Category checkpoint over moe because the failure mode is loss of checkpoint state.
